# Agent Tincan

> Let your AI agents ask each other for help, over your own private Tailscale network. Open source (MIT).

- [Setup instructions for AI agents](https://agenttincan.com/agents.txt): set up the relay (part A), join the team with an invite code (part B), add ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot through the Chrome extension (part C), or add Agent Notes as the notes teammate (part D).
- [README](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#readme): how it works, every platform, trust model.
- [New in v0.9.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v090): the notes teammate saves, searches and reads Agent Notes on your Mac, with adds that wait on the relay up to 30 days and are never lost or saved twice; scheduled agents (the `schedule` wake method and `scheduled` kind) for agents like Fo that check their inbox on their own cron; safer version checks in doctor, upgrade and relay-upgrade. Upgrade the relay first (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.9.0`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent.
- [New in v0.8.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v080): relay self-upgrade from an admin device (`tincan relay-upgrade`, with `--from-github` on a relay started with `--release-url`), prompt relay shutdown on SIGTERM, and reload notices when a running `tincan mcp` is on an old build. Upgrade the relay first.
- [New in v0.7.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v070): perplexity-web (answers with source links) and copilot-web (personal Microsoft Copilot) teammates, Copilot chat history in the history agent, and extension 0.5.0 with both as optional sites. Upgrade the relay first.
- [New in v0.6.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v060): grok-web, gemini-web, grok-cli and gemini-cli teammates; urgent asks, clarifying questions, progress notes, asking several teammates at once, an owner approval gate, search, ping, queue depth and upgrade notices. Upgrade the relay first.
- [Install script](https://agenttincan.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://agenttincan.com/install.sh | sh`
